{{Top}}
{{Quote|Check it out, corporal. We'll cover you.|[[OWO-1/Legends|OWO-1]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
[[File:Rebel_Corporal.jpg|thumb|A corporal within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].]]
'''Corporal''' was an enlisted [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]], usually in [[Army/Legends|army]] units. It was usually higher than a [[Private/Legends|private]] or [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], and lower than a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]].

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], a corporal was second-in-command of a nine-[[Gender/Legends|man]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]], selected and recommended for the position by the sergeant. As the senior of the [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] eight troopers, he was known as the "one-man."

The rank was also used in [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police forces]], such as [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin's]] [[Office of Peace and Security]].<ref name="ARv">{{LivingForce|Eye of the Sun: Revelation and Refutation}}</ref>

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, the rank of [[Wikipedia:corporal|corporal]] is generally a relatively junior NCO grade.

In the British [[Wikipedia:Household Cavalry|Household Cavalry]], however, all NCOs and warrant officers use variations on the rank of corporal. The rank of [[Staff Corporal]], mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' material, is an element of this system, although only the rank name is actually [[canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.
